name: Kimi ga Ita Toshoshitsu
source:
The protagonist is a third-year college student. He's been placed in charge of the library and stays after hours. That's how he meets a lone book-loving girl. His job and her passion lead to deeper conversations...

... But they're not the only ones talking. A popular and well-known freshman is also after her. "It's strange to only read books.
You need to experience more of life.Don't you want to do what normal college girls do?"

From a small misunderstanding, a crack forms.
Slowly but surely, her mind and body are pried open... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE077638.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角是大学三年级学生，负责管理图书馆，经常在闭馆后留下。也正因如此，他遇见了一名独自读书、热爱书籍的女孩。工作与她的爱好让两人的话题逐渐深入……

但与她交谈的不止主角。一个广受欢迎、颇有名气的大一男生也在追求她。“只读书也太奇怪了。你应该多体验人生。不想做些普通女大学生会做的事吗？”

一场小小的误会造成了裂痕。她的心与身体被一点点撬开……

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE077638.html]DLsite English[/url]]
